risk_note: RV2 by the gate (contract and generated route files beside notification, RV1). Implements the two planned settings operations of CT-02t on app.notification_settings (B1-12l, 0065): GET returns the caller's three switches (app_id and user_id), or all three true when the account has no row, without inserting; PUT replaces all three (exactly service_push, subscription_push, marketing_push booleans; missing, extra or non-boolean fields are 20001) with one INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (app_id, user_id) DO UPDATE that sets only the three switches, row_version + 1 and updated_at (the columns couli_app may update), so concurrent first saves leave one row and never a 5xx; created_at and updated_at come from the injected Clock. The switches only gate push (BR-WATCH-19, BR-WATCH-15); inbox writing is unchanged and the send path reading them is a later task. Version gate and the h5 read-only scope come from the generated platform route tables. The planned flag is dropped from both operations and the route schemas are regenerated. No money, no attribution.
